ReviewI.Integration.finite_interval_shell_boundary_physical.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0)
  (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (indent : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ) (hindcont : Continuous indent)
  (hind : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ indent x)
  (hmass : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun t => indent ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x)) 1)
  (q : Fin 2) (t : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) (omega : ℝ → ℝ → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hm : ∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → AEStronglyMeasurable (omega L e) mu)
  (hb : ∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖omega L e x‖ ≤ 1)
  (hplateau :
    ∀ (L e : ℝ),
      FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e →
        ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          L⁻¹ + e ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
            Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ L - e → omega L e x = 1) :
  let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have p := NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent;
  have d := fun x => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b E A (fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹)) x x;
  HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d x ∂mu)
      (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)) ∧
    HasSum (fun e => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d x ∂mu) 0 ∧
      (Summable fun e => ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d x ∂mu‖) ∧
        ∑' (e : Option ℕ), ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), (↑(p e x) - ↑(p e (x * t⁻¹))) * d x ∂mu‖ ≤
            2 * ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖d x‖ ∂mu ∧
          Tendsto
            (fun z =>
              ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
                ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * (omega z.1 (z.2 / z.1) x * d x) ∂mu -
                    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(p e x) * d x ∂mu‖)
            FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 0)
